args.message: The table has 12 rows: one per region and city, with the city's revenue (sum of order amounts) and its region's total revenue on the same row. Region and city are taken from each order's customer. Oslo appears twice, under North and under South, because customers in both regions list it as their city. Orders whose customer has no known region form a null-region group. Inside that group, Paris customers are on their own row and customers with no city are on a null-city row. The two rows together total 1193.3.
